description: Read your Homebase schedules, timecards, employees and labor costs, and start workflows when shifts change or employees clock in and out.

homebase_employee_clocked_in_trigger.description: Runs when an employee clocks in at a Homebase location.

output.approved: Whether a manager has approved it.
output.clock_out: When they clocked out (ISO 8601), empty while still clocked in.
output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.
output.shift_id: The shift it was worked against.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_employee_clocked_out_trigger.description: Runs when an employee clocks out at a Homebase location, with the hours and tips on their timecard.

output.approved: Whether a manager has approved it.
output.clock_out: When they clocked out (ISO 8601), empty while still clocked in.
output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.
output.shift_id: The shift it was worked against.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_employee_updated_trigger.description: Runs when an employee's details, role or wage change at a Homebase location.

output.job: Their job at the location: level, default_role, pin, payroll_id, wage_rate, wage_type, roles and archived_at.
output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs when an employee is added to a Homebase location. People already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.job: Their job at the location: level, default_role, pin, payroll_id, wage_rate, wage_type, roles and archived_at.
output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_new_shift_trigger.description: Runs when a shift is added to a Homebase location's schedule.

output.first_name: The employee's first name (empty for an open shift).
output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.
output.open: Whether it is an open shift anyone can claim.
output.published: Whether the schedule with it is published.
output.scheduled: False if it was made by someone clocking in unscheduled.
output.timecard_id: The timecard worked against it, if any.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_shift_deleted_trigger.description: Runs when a shift is removed from a Homebase location's schedule.

output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_shift_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a shift on a Homebase location's schedule is changed, such as its time, its employee or being published.

output.first_name: The employee's first name (empty for an open shift).
output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.
output.open: Whether it is an open shift anyone can claim.
output.published: Whether the schedule with it is published.
output.scheduled: False if it was made by someone clocking in unscheduled.
output.timecard_id: The timecard worked against it, if any.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_timecard_deleted_trigger.description: Runs when a timecard is deleted at a Homebase location.

output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid

homebase_timecard_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a timecard at a Homebase location changes, such as a clock-out, an edited time or a manager's approval.

output.approved: Whether a manager has approved it.
output.clock_out: When they clocked out (ISO 8601), empty while still clocked in.
output.location_uuid: The id of the location watched.
output.shift_id: The shift it was worked against.

parameters.description: The Homebase location to watch.
parameters.name: location_uuid
